evidence: Three-month-old male Sprague-Dawley rats (weighing approximately 300 g) were purchased from the Hunan SLAC Laboratory Animal Center (Changsha, China).
Rat myocardial tissues were immunoprecipitated using anti-ubiquitin affinity magnetic beads.
The ubiquitination sites for the KDM1A protein in the immunoprecipitates were analyzed using mass spectrometry.
Cardiomyocytes (NRVMs) were infected with lentiviruses carrying the Flag-KDM1A plasmid, and cell lysates were immunoprecipitated using anti-Flag affinity magnetic beads.
